svg.title: Teens on Wegovy or Saxenda: side effects vs placebo
svg.desc: Teens on Wegovy or Saxenda: side effects vs placebo. Vomiting, Wegovy (teens, STEP TEENS): placebo 10%, drug 36%. Vomiting, Wegovy (adults): placebo 6%, drug 24%. Vomiting, Saxenda (teens): placebo 4%, drug 34.4%. Nausea, Wegovy (teens): placebo 18%, drug 42%. Nausea, Wegovy (adults): placebo 16%, drug 44%. Gallstones, Wegovy (teens): placebo 0%, drug 3.8%. Gallstones, Wegovy (adults): placebo 0.7%, drug 1.6%.
